name: Taller IA Nacion Seguros
postCreateCommand: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -c "from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer; SentenceTransformer('intfloat/multilingual-e5-small')" && (test -f .env || cp .env.example .env)
postAttachCommand: echo 'Entorno listo. Completa ANTHROPIC_API_KEY en .env, activa con: source .venv/bin/activate y corre: python check_setup.py'
